headline: 8-year-old girl dies after falling into drain in Cumilla
summary: The child slipped from her mother's hand and fell into a rain-filled drain in the Chotora Eidgah area on Sunday night.
details: An 8-year-old girl named Smriti died after falling into a rain-filled drain in the Chotora Eidgah area of Cumilla city on Sunday night.
The incident occurred around 9 PM while Smriti and her mother were returning home from a wedding invitation.
Heavy rainfall had flooded several roads in the area, hiding the open drain beneath the water.
Witnesses say the child suddenly slipped from her mother's hand and fell into the drain, where she was swept away by the current.
Local residents launched a rescue operation immediately and managed to recover her after approximately 20 minutes.
She was rushed to a nearby hospital, where the duty doctor declared her dead on arrival.
caption:
A tragic accident in Cumilla claims the life of an 8-year-old girl who fell into a hidden, rain-filled drain.

An 8-year-old girl named Smriti died after falling into a rain-filled drain in the Chotora Eidgah area of Cumilla city on Sunday night.

The incident occurred around 9 PM while Smriti and her mother were returning home from a wedding invitation.

Heavy rainfall had flooded several roads in the area, hiding the open drain beneath the water.

Witnesses say the child suddenly slipped from her mother's hand and fell into the drain, where she was swept away by the current.

Local residents launched a rescue operation immediately and managed to recover her after approximately 20 minutes.

She was rushed to a nearby hospital, where the duty doctor declared her dead on arrival.

Source: Jamuna TV, Somoy News
